newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields up on Bulgaria 3-, 12-mth discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields up on Bulgaria 3-, 12-mth discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields rose at Monday's auctions of Bulgarian Finance Ministry three-month and 12-month discount T-bills as both issues were heavily oversubscribed, Finance Ministry figures showed.

The three-month paper yielded 1.40 percent, up from 1.38 percent for the respective maturity auctioned a week ago, and yield to maturity on the 12-month issue rose to 9.18 percent from 8.74 percent at the previuos auction on July 21.
The two issues auctioned on Monday were offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
Bids received 9.408 bln levs 17.687 bln levs
Average price of bids 98.51 pct 90.98 pct
Bids approved 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
Average yield to maturity 1.40 pct 9.18 pct
